info.title: viggle/text-to-motion
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "viggle/text-to-motion", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

schema.description: JSON body of a Viggle Motion generated from text, as a 3D animation.

example.text: a person waves with the right hand

duration_seconds.description: Animation length in seconds, 3 to 60. Defaults to 5.

guidance_scale.description: How strongly the animation follows the text, 0 to 30. Defaults to 5.

smooth.description: Smooths the generated animation. Defaults to true.

text.description: The movement to generate, 1 to 400 characters.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description: Comfy Router output schema for Viggle 3D animations: the ready `GET /proxy/viggle/v1/motions/{motion_id}/files` document. `glb` and `fbx` each carry a skeleton for the Mixamo, MetaHuman and MetaHuman Body rigs. The URLs are Viggle's and expire after one hour.

ViggleError.description: Viggle's error object, set when the job failed.

ViggleMotionFiles.description: A Viggle 3D animation and, once ready, its files.

credits_used.description: Viggle credits the job is charged, set once it is ready.

status.description: Status: queued, processing, ready or failed.

ViggleMotionRigFiles.description: Download URLs of one file format, one per rig.
